title: the 48 GB run on an existing host: one card of several, any card size

findings.claim: on a machine with several cards the 48 GB run would measure a card other than the ballast's: deploy/docker-compose.dgpu48.yml asks Docker for count: 1 (whichever card it lists first), the ballast's holder took --gpus device=<index>, and tools/ballast.py and tools/ballast48.py read every card's line without -i
findings.severity_basis: a run on the existing host of eight cards could hold one card and start the servers on another, so its records would say 'by ballast' of a card that was not held; not reached: no run there has happened
findings.fix: one card by --gpu-index: every nvidia-smi question with -i, the UUID checked at every read (card-changed refused), the holder pinned by UUID, the two servers pinned by gpu-pin.yml (device_ids, !override) and proven before the start (compose's resolved configuration) and after it (each container's device request); stand-ins in tests/unit/test_ballast_any_card_h67.py

findings.claim: tools/ballast.py's memory-already-held refusal named every other compute process by pid and process name; on a shared machine that is another user's information, and records/ballast.log is in the packed records
findings.severity_basis: information about another user's work in a record that is sent back; no run on a shared machine has happened
findings.fix: the refusal names how many processes and how much memory, never a pid or a name; the host form's preflight does the same

findings.claim: tools/measure48-vm.sh's steps assume a machine made for the run: s05 prunes Docker's whole build cache and every dangling image, s14 runs pkill -f 'tools.ballast hold', and the stop line's SIGINT goes to any process matching a pattern; on a shared host these reach other users' objects and processes
findings.severity_basis: right on the VM made and deleted for the run; would touch other users' objects if the steps ran unchanged on a shared host
findings.fix: the step functions are shared, with the machine's own parts named: tools/measure48-host.sh frees only the stub's volumes, never prunes, and reaches only its own processes (OWN_ONLY); its Docker objects are listed and removed at the end; the VM keeps its behaviour
